subject: Mostly unneeded
author: Wei
body:
As the devs have noted on the podcasts, there is not really any need for a speedometer in the game.  Speedometers were in the older games just to let you know you were going fast in the game.  You do not really need a speedometer in Paradise to know you are going fast.

That said, I would be curious to know how fast the cars actually are.  I doubt I would want the speedometer on a regular basis, though.  If it is added, I would want an on/off toggle, so I can turn it off when I am actually trying to do something in the game other than just having fun.
